Manifest.Note: Five retained synthetic datasets, two public corpora, and two new deterministic fixtures. Mixed content and misleading extensions test the content selector. Each Auto call includes sampling and trials in wall time. Outcomes are estimates, not oracle choices.

Note: Separate fresh processes; cold GPU context initialization included each run, warm OS cache; no CPU/GPU/thermal or background-load isolation. Codec framing and ratio may differ by backend.
